title: BPMN activities, extracted (folio-assistant-sci)
description: Candidate terms extracted from every BPMN task and call activity: `name` as the label, its own `<documentation>` as the definition, the element id as the code. Generated by folio-assistant-core/scripts/glossary-extract.ts; not curated, and never hand-edited: a person promotes a term by authoring it in a glossary of their own.

terms.definition: Run gen_atomic_mass.py --check: regenerate AtomicMass.lean from the data table and diff it against the committed file. Any divergence exits 1 with a unified diff and fails the PR — a Lean file that compiles must not carry numbers the table no longer produces.

terms.prefLabel: Build the doc-gen4 render over the warm cache
terms.definition: Tool `lean-html-docs` (`adapters/paper/lean/lean-docs-build.sh --lake-root <pkg> --lib <Lib>`). Refuses while another lake/lean process holds `.lake/`, refuses over a restored tree with no traces, checks or restores the warm cache, enables the sentinel-commented doc-gen4 require for this build only, then `lake -R -Kenv=dev build <Lib>:docs`. Output: `<pkg>/.lake/build/doc`.

terms.prefLabel: Stage the render under the site and rail every page
terms.definition: Tool `lean-render-publish` (`adapters/paper/lean/lean-render.ts --docs <render> --site <site>`). Copies the render to `<site>/lean/` without Lake's bookkeeping, marks doc-gen4's iframe navbar and `find/` redirect rail-declined, adds the layout shim, optionally prunes to the folio's modules, then runs `rail-standalone-pages.ts --foreign-site` over the whole site and checks every staged page.

Process_BeanClose: end the bean in a state that says why — complete and archive it, scrap it with its reasons and archive it, or record the blocker and hand it back. The one place resolve and archive are drawn (bean m8gz, owner 2026-10-24); placed straight before the end so the engine's resolve sees nothing left but the archive step.

Process_BeanOpen: check before you create, find out whose the bean is, and claim it — or leave it alone when it is someone else's. The one place a claim is drawn (bean m8gz, owner 2026-10-24); the gateway after this reads which end it reached.

Core's shared review-and-publish process (Process_FolioReviewPublish): the reviewer reads the rendered folio and approves it, asks for changes, or sends a working draft to the Authoring Committee. Before 2026-11-01 each authoring process drew these steps itself (shared block G6, owner Q-BR-7 A).
Every block edit runs the HCI validation gate — see editing-hci-validation.bpmn.

Give each formal block (definition, theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary, conjecture, proof) a .lean sibling that Lean 4 accepts, in the order lean-formalization sets out. A compiling declaration is not a formalised claim: check vacuity and narrative drift before calling it done, and record the status with proof-verification.
Scope the paper: chapters, the blocks each needs, what gets formalised.

Typeset the paper through LaTeX to PDF and HTML. Run latex_preflight first — missing packages, fonts or engine — rather than discovering them twenty minutes in. The preamble, class and macros belong to the folio, never to the platform.

Create the folio repository with `bun run cat init-folio` (or the folio_init tool): content/, the document, chapter and first block manifests, the builder shim, AGENTS.md, .mcp.json, the session-start hook and the beans store, with the platform linked rather than copied.
The plan becomes beans, so a resumed session or a sibling agent can pick it up.
Run content validation over the folio: schemas, the content profile (formal kinds only in a paper), cross-block consistency and that the Lean builds. Loop back rather than rendering over a failure.
